name: VuePress
description: VuePress is a Vue powered static site generator that turns Markdown into static HTML pages, with a Vite or webpack bundler.
notes: Pinned to VuePress 2.0.0-rc.31 (no 2.x stable release exists; npm latest is 1.9.10, the v2 line ships as release candidates). Uses @vuepress/bundler-vite and a minimal local theme (one layout rendering only the page content, with a post list on the index built from a temp data file written by the theme's onPrepared hook); no default theme, navbar, sidebar or search. firstRelease from npm vuepress creation (2018-04-12).
